focus: 今天的重點：聽位置 under、數數量、Who…?、Do you…?、讀作息表找時間和地點、Is 開頭的問句、用 and 連接。
notes: 聽力第 1 題：on（在上面）、under（在下面）、next to（在旁邊）三個位置一起出現，可以拿家裡的桌子和玩具，請 Kyro 邊放邊說。
閱讀段落填空第 1 格：主詞是 Kane and I（兩個人），動詞不加 s：swim。可以和昨天的 she drinks 對照。
寫作第 1 題：把 is 搬到句子最前面，句尾改成問號；看圖寫句第 1 行 7:30 可以寫 seven thirty。

listen.why: 貓咪在桌子的下面：under the table。on 是在上面，next to 是在旁邊。

listen.q: How many red apples are there?
listen.why: 數一數，有 7 顆蘋果：seven。eleven 是十一，six 是六。

talk: Who is your English teacher, Kyro?
listen.why: Who 問「是誰」，要回答一個人：Ms. Lee is（是李老師）。

talk: Do you have a pet, Kyro?
listen.why: Do you 開頭的問句，用 Yes 或 No 回答：Yes, I have a dog（有，我有一隻狗）。

talk: Kyro, we need milk and eggs.
Can we get some apples, too?
listen.q: How many apples will they buy?
listen.why: 媽媽說 Let's buy six apples：要買六顆蘋果。

talk: That's Kane. He is my brother.
listen.why: Kyro 說 He is my brother：Kane 是他的哥哥。

talk: Hi, Kyro. It's Dad. I am at the shop. I want to buy a cake for Grandma. Does she like a cake with fruit? Please call me back.
listen.q: What does Dad want to buy for Grandma?
listen.why: 爸爸在電話留言說 I want to buy a cake for Grandma：要買蛋糕給奶奶。

talk: I have a new toy. It is round and blue. I can throw it and kick it. I play with it in the park with my dog every day.
listen.q: What is the girl's new toy?
listen.why: 她說新玩具 round and blue（圓圓的、藍色），可以丟也可以踢，是藍色的球。

vocab.stem: An elephant is not small. It is very ____.
vocab.why: 大象不小（not small），所以是很大：big。

vocab.stem: Mr. Chen lives next to us. He is our ____.
vocab.why: 住在我們家隔壁的人是鄰居：neighbor，是學校 LA 的單字。

vocab.stem: Amy is my friend. I like ____ very much.
vocab.why: Amy 是女生，放在 like 後面要用 her。she 只能放在句子開頭當主詞。

cloze.passage: Dear Grandpa, We are at the beach today. The sky is blue and the sun is hot. Kane and I {1} in the water. Dad has a new camera. {2} takes a lot of pictures. See you soon. Love, Kyro

items.why: 主詞是 Kane and I（兩個人），動詞不加 s：swim。
前一句說的是 Dad（爸爸），男生用 He。

text.intro: 讀下面 Kyro 星期六的作息表，回答三個問題。
text.title: Kyro's Saturday

items.stem: What does Kyro do at nine?
items.why: 作息表第一行：9:00 Swimming class，九點上游泳課。
4:00 Soccer in the park：在公園踢足球。
最後一行 6:00 Dinner at home：六點在家吃晚餐。

near: 問句要把 Is 搬到最前面：Is Kane ...?
有 is 的句子，把 is 搬到前面就好，不用 do/does。
kitchen 前面要有 in the。
hints: 把 is 搬到句子最前面，第一個字母要大寫。

write.instr: 用 and 把兩個句子合成一句。
accept: i have a cat and a dog
i have a cat and i have a dog
write.model: I have a cat and a dog.
near: 兩個都有，用 and，不是 or。
兩件事都一樣是「有」，用 and，不是 but。
cat 和 a dog 中間要加 and。
hints: 兩句都是 I have，只要說一次 I have。
I have a cat ___ a dog.

write.instr: 依照順序點字卡，排成一句話。
hints: 大寫字母開頭的字放第一個，有句點的字放最後。
時鐘是七點半：seven thirty；帽子是綠色：green。
